lines.text: With the wall rebuilt and the doors set, Nehemiah put Hanani in charge and ordered the gates kept shut until the sun was hot.
The city was large but had few people, so God put it in Nehemiah's heart to enroll the people by genealogy.
Nehemiah found the register of those who first returned from captivity in Babylon, where Darius had carried them away.
Some priests could not find their family records, so the governor told them not to eat the most holy things until a priest consulted the Ephod.

wrong_details.true: a priest consulted the Urim and Thummim

lines.text: The whole assembly numbered 42,360, and by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their own towns.
